concept.title: Using Clause Library for Template v202408.1.0
concept.shortdesc: Clause Library is a library of clauses, or clause templates, that each contains modular blocks

conbody.p: Clause Library is a library of clauses, or clause templates, that each contains modular blocks of contractual language that can be reused across multiple contract templates. Clause Library helps you to search for clauses or supporting documents that can be inserted into the template as inline text.
Clauses are not supported in headers and footers in templates
